component.name: Tailscale
component.summary: Manage your tailnet from the COSMIC desktop

description.p: A native Tailscale client for the COSMIC desktop. It talks to the local tailscaled daemon over its UNIX socket, so it reflects the real state of your tailnet without shelling out to the command line.

ul.li: Browse every machine on your tailnet with live connection paths
Switch exit nodes, or offer this machine as one
Send files with Taildrop by dropping them onto the window
Open a Tailscale SSH session in cosmic-term with one click
Review what this machine publishes with serve and funnel
